<reason>CON made the motion easier to decide: the stated warrant is unmapped seafloor, and crewed vehicles are a poor, interruptible way to buy coverage. PRO never neutralized that mismatch after conceding crews would still be funded even if robots finished the map faster, then substituting occupation/political will. CON also refused austerity, so the live choice was equal-scale allocation, not stinginess versus ambition.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON’s Q2 and the A2 follow-through: PRO said yes, still put people in even if uncrewed mapping would be faster; CON used that to show the “given unmapped seafloor” clause no longer supported the crewed remedy.</best_rebuttal>
